The ring and the temperatures by mouth are checked apart; when both find it within 2 days, it is clear. In made up cycles with a rise of 0.3 °C and night to night noise of 0.1 °C, the rule found 7 in 10 rises and a clear one was within 1 day of the real ovulation 4 times in 5. With noise of 0.2 °C it finds about a third. Illness, alcohol, travel and a warm room move the temperature too.
